event.description: Test midpoint query-key width 14 with full values
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 2,128 parameters at 99.140000%, a +0.140000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 2 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted in-family result is attempt-0020, projection-free full-width attention at 3,168 parameters and 99.94%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0035, shared query/key width 12 with full values, which peaked at 97.85% internal validation. The retained full-width shared attention uses query/key width 16. Hypothesis: the routing-capacity transition lies between widths 12 and 16; width 14 restores one feature per head, saves 64 parameters, and yields 2,064. This parameterization-preserving midpoint is more informative than the nearest alternative because it exactly bisects the measured same-topology accepted/failed bracket while leaving values, residuals, normalizers, data, and training unchanged.
